item.title: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration — Procurement: 26SSEIT22001-Subscription of 3 Consumer Data Statara Licenses
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The Statara consumer dataset provides information on over 5.5 million adult New Yorkers. This serves as a single data source that provides far broader coverage than PEU can get from various partner agency sources. Having this broad coverage is critical during emergencies and also helps PEU reach New Yorkers who have fewer existing touchpoints with the City. Without the consumer file in question, PEU s efforts to reach out to underserved New Yorkers, especially during and after emergencies, will be greatly impaired.
